name: M1 string (Projectionism / Frame Freeze passive)
air: no uppercut or downslam (disabled by the passive; items like Playful Cloud or Naginata override this)
combo: 4th hit is a knockback with evadable stun, not a launcher; builds Projection toward a 3s frame freeze
description: Passive cuts the M1 string to 4 hits of 2 damage and removes uppercuts and downslams; the last hit always knocks back with an evadable stun and adds Projection (35% on a target with no meter, 30% at 60% or below, 100% above 60%, 40% with a Bleed stack). At 100% Projection the target freezes in a glass frame for 3s; Projection moves that miss, are blocked or are interrupted put the meter on the user instead, and it drains 2%/s (1.3%/s with a Bleed stack).

name: Projection Breaker
combo: knockback ender that resets the M1 count; main Projection builder (80% on a clean target)
when_it_whiffs: blockable (a forum tip says a fast reaction can block it); the backdash puts him 15 studs away before the kick, and a miss or block puts Projection on the user
description: Naoya dashes 15 studs backwards with short melee i-frames, then spins back in with a heavy kick that throws the target away; his M1 count resets afterwards. Applies Projection: 80% on a target with no meter, 35% if they already have meter, 50% on a framed target. A wiki forum post (looks like a fan rebalance, unverified) instead lists 8 damage, 25%, no backdash and a semi guard break.

name: Bleedout
damage: 5 stab + 3 per Bleed stack (x3) + 1.3 per Hemorrhage tick (39 ticks)
combo: not a true extender per the wiki; applies Bleed/Hemorrhage (slows Projection drain on the target); guides use 3 M1s > dash > Bleedout
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; a forum comment says it has to follow an M1 or the target is i-framed (unverified)
description: A tanto stab that applies 3 Bleed stacks plus a Hemorrhage damage-over-time; hitting a target that already has Bleed refreshes the stacks to 3 and applies a new Hemorrhage. Has a separate finisher on targets at 15 HP or less; one forum tip says it bypasses block, matching the wiki's UNBLOCKABLE tag.

name: Decisive Strike
combo: multi-stage extender; guides chain M1s > Decisive Strike > Cursory Impact; after stage 3 pressing move 1 gives the heavy-swing follow-up
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; stages 1-2 can be blocked; windup looks like Projection Sorcery and Cursory Impact
description: Naoya runs forward into a jab, then a slap, then a 14-hit flurry; each stage is reached by pressing the move again. First and second uses are blockable, the third (which extends the rush further) is unblockable; if blocked the default version knocks the enemy back and its endlag is 0.2s shorter. Projection: 30% if the enemy already has meter, 15% on a framed target, none on a target with no meter; first stage has melee i-frames.

name: Decisive Strike follow-up (heavy swing, press 1 after stage 3)
damage: 12 (36 if enemy interrupted, 24 if enemy ragdolled)
combo: finisher at the end of Decisive Strike; best as a punish/interrupt (36)
when_it_whiffs: only available after Decisive Strike stage 3; wiki says missing it 'grants the user a frame' (the user gets framed)
description: After the third stage of Decisive Strike, pressing move 1 throws an unblockable heavy swing: 12 damage normally, 36 if it interrupts the enemy, 24 if the enemy is ragdolled. It puts both move 1 and move 3 on cooldown.

name: Cursory Impact
combo: knockback finisher after M1s/Decisive Strike; biggest payoff on a target he has frozen in a frame
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; windup resembles Projection Sorcery and Decisive Strike; a miss puts Projection on the user
description: Naoya quick-steps to his destination with a burst of speed and throws a backhanded smack; on a non-framed enemy it is followed by a kick that knocks them away (40% Projection, 20% per hit; neither hit can frame, they cap Projection at 99%). On a framed target the smack launches them up and he catches and tosses them (19.5 slap + 5 toss, no Projection; the bonus only applies if he was the one who framed them). Current wiki page says UNBLOCKABLE; an older forum note says it could be perfect-blocked, and patch logs list the first hit as 7 to 8 vs the 7.5 on the page.

name: Projection Sorcery
combo: reposition/gap closer; used in neutral or after an M1 set to bait counters and evasives; punch variant launches a framed target
when_it_whiffs: second teleport needs a target in sight; can be interrupted
description: Teleports up to 50 studs in about a second leaving an afterimage, with one more teleport allowed before the cooldown starts but only if a target is in sight; if the first projection is interrupted the special stays off cooldown. Its variant is a melee punch (listed 9 damage, 35% Projection; the page history contradicts itself on this) that launches the target away and resets the M1 count. Wiki lists 18s cooldown; a third-party guide says 16s and notes the punch can launch a frozen target for bonus frame damage.

name: Vengeance (awakening activation)
when_it_whiffs: slow windup; any melee hit during the activation reverses it onto the user
description: Awakening is entered by performing Bleedout with a slowed-down windup. If Naoya is hit by a melee attack at any point during it, the attacker catches the thrust and stabs him with his own knife. Bloxodes lists 90 HP in base and 75 HP in awakening.

name: Top Speed
combo: payoff for stacking Acceleration; combine with Flash Freezing frames for longer flight
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; weak (5 damage) without Acceleration stacks
description: A flying charge whose damage scales with how many times Acceleration has been used (momentum bar, max seven uses); at higher speeds it gains bullet and explosion properties. Flying through Flash Freezing's frames extends the flight and adds 0.6 damage per frame (up to 15), but frames broken this way deal no damage themselves.

name: Flash Freezing
combo: lays a line of frames that Top Speed can fly through
when_it_whiffs: line in front of the user only
description: Freezes the air in front of Naoya into a line of 15 glass frames, each dealing 7 damage. A separate finisher version is an instant kill (trigger condition not stated in the source).

name: Tendril Grab
combo: setup: ~1s immobilise for a follow-up
when_it_whiffs: no enemy within 25 studs
description: Naoya plunges his arm underground and tendrils surge out to grab every enemy within 25 studs, immobilising them for roughly a second. Deals no damage.

name: Time Cell Moon Palace
combo: domain; punishes any enemy action for 25s, ends awakening
when_it_whiffs: interruptible on cast; enemies who stand still or block take little or nothing
description: A 25-second domain in which every opponent must obey the 24 FPS rule: any movement or action (including ragdoll and wake-up) freezes and shatters their cells for 1 damage per tick. Blocking is excluded and greatly reduces the damage taken from walking. Using it ends the awakening.

name: Acceleration
combo: stacking tool: 7 uses max out Top Speed's damage
when_it_whiffs: no speed gain if blocked; cannot finish a kill
description: Awakening (Vengeance) special: Naoya spins rapidly, damaging the area around him and raising his walk speed if the hit is not blocked. Each use fills the momentum bar toward maximum Top Speed (seven uses). Costs no awakening meter and cannot kill.

name: M1 string
combo: final M1 or uppercut cashes in a Ratio mark for bonus damage
description: No M1 damage numbers were found. The wiki states that on a Ratio-marked target the final neutral M1 and the uppercut deal increased damage and consume the mark.

name: Ratio Point
combo: setup: mark then land a Ratio-enhanced move for bonus damage/unblockable variants
when_it_whiffs: no target within 70 studs; mistimed second press gives no weak point; weak point expires after 4.5s
description: Marks one target within 70 studs and starts a timing bar above their head (the circle moves faster the lower their health); pressing the special again when the circle reaches the 7:3 line creates a weak point for 4.5s. Final M1, uppercut, Cleaving Whirlwind, Blunt Cut and Stabilize then deal increased damage and remove the mark. Cooldown starts once the bar is gone, and is skipped if a move interrupts the marked opponent; in awakening the cooldown is removed but only one target can be marked.

name: Cleaving Whirlwind
combo: gap closer / knockback ender; follow-up out of Stabilize
when_it_whiffs: blockable and interruptible; straight 25-stud charge
description: Nanami charges 25 studs forward while spinning (melee i-frames during the charge) and ends with a downward slash that knocks the opponent away. On a Ratio-marked target it becomes a stronger version that can also lower the target's block angle. Can be used to break out of Stabilize's shared stun.

name: Severance Kick
combo: spacing/knockback tool; stun is evadable so not a guaranteed extender
when_it_whiffs: damage can be blocked (knockback still applies)
description: A kick that pushes the target away with an evadable stun (or ragdoll); listed as semi-blockable because blocking does not stop the knockback. It can also kick throwables at the enemy for more damage.

name: Blunt Cut
combo: gap closer that also hits ragdolled targets; follow-up out of Stabilize
when_it_whiffs: blockable without a Ratio mark; interruptible during the charge
description: Nanami charges a quick swing, flash-steps 34 studs forward and swings his blade almost instantly; can be held for more damage. On a Ratio-marked target it is unblockable, deals 13 (18 held) and disables the target's dashes for 7s if it interrupts their action (blocking included). Can be used to break out of Stabilize's shared stun.

name: Stabilize
combo: unblockable starter: stun, then cancel into Cleaving Whirlwind or Blunt Cut
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; cannot hit grounded ragdolled targets; melee range only
description: Nanami pulls his arm back and thrusts his blade into the opponent's stomach, then twirls it. On hit both players are stunned in place briefly, and he can leave the stun early by using Cleaving Whirlwind or Blunt Cut. Deals 10 instead of 6 when it interrupts the enemy (or hits a Ratio-marked target, per the variant text).

name: Overtime (awakening activation)
description: Awakening: heals 25 HP (reduced from 75 in an earlier patch) and lasts 60 seconds. Ratio Point loses its cooldown while awakened.

name: Ratio Breaker I
damage: 10, 5 per hit (10 to either with Ratio, up to 20)
combo: stage 1 of 4; needs Ratio marks to chain into II-IV
when_it_whiffs: without a Ratio mark on the target the chain ends and resets to stage I
description: First of four stages on one button (a cleaver hit, per patch notes, that now wakes up ragdolled enemies). Landing it on a Ratio-marked target skips the cooldown so the next stage can follow; otherwise the move goes on its 19s cooldown (reduced from 22s) and resets to stage I.

name: Ratio Breaker II
combo: stage 2 of 4
when_it_whiffs: the sequence resets to stage I after a use that fails to hit a Ratio-marked target
description: A single straight punch charged with cursed energy that triggers a Black Flash on hit; Nanami has melee i-frames during it.

name: Ratio Breaker III
combo: stage 3 of 4; area hit
when_it_whiffs: interruptible during the hop/windup
description: A long hop into a heavy slam that hits anyone in the landing area with an explosion of black sparks.

name: Ratio Breaker IV
combo: stage 4 finisher of the Ratio Breaker chain
when_it_whiffs: fourth stage of the sequence, which resets to stage I after a use that fails to hit a Ratio-marked target
description: Nanami dashes roughly 60 studs with a swipe into a Black Flash; it prioritises Ratio-marked targets, then low-HP opponents. The Black Flash hits a single target and cannot kill, but its follow-up can kill and blows away enemies near the target. A separate finisher version is an insta-kill (22s cooldown).

name: Sharpen
combo: unblockable launcher / gap closer; also picks up ragdolled targets
description: Nanami slides 45 studs forward and slices upward, launching the target. Has melee i-frames (added in a patch); cooldown was reduced from 22s to 20s.

name: Interrogate
combo: unblockable grab; safe due to i-frames
description: Nanami catches the target and drives a punch into their gut. The windup and the rest of the move have i-frames and awakening drain pauses during it; the grab part can no longer kill. Punch is listed as 15 (an older section of the page says 10); its finisher removes Ratio marks.

name: Collapse
damage: 5 slam + 7 impact (15 with Ratio); recast: 40 per debris, max 80
combo: two-part: slam, then recast to drop debris on the area
when_it_whiffs: debris only falls where it was left; enemies have up to 8s to leave the area
description: Nanami leaps and slams the ground, leaving debris suspended in the air; using the move again drops the debris (40 per piece, capped at 80; a forum post says a cap was later cut 40 to 35), and unused debris falls by itself after 8 seconds. Classed as melee/explosion; Erosion can cancel it.

name: M1 string
damage: 14 total over 4 hits (as stated under Unwrap)
description: The only M1 number found is from the awakening entry: Unwrap resets melee to a 4-hit M1 string totalling 14 damage. Base M1 details were not found.

name: Lasso (passive front dash)
combo: ranged pull-in to start a string
description: Passive: Hanami's front dash is replaced by a ranged grab that pulls a target in for 4 damage on a 10s cooldown.

name: Plant Guidance
air: variants trigger only when the follow-up move is used in the air or during another action
combo: setup: mark a spot, then trigger a move from it while doing something else
when_it_whiffs: spot is fixed once placed (enemy must be at the mark); follow-up used on the ground and idle gives the normal move instead
description: Aiming the special anywhere within 65 studs marks a spot on the ground (only the user can see it until it is used). Using Surging Thorns, Defense Response or Root Swarm while airborne or mid-action then fires that move's special variant from the marked spot; rblxguide adds that a move used on the mark costs no move cooldown and gives the special's cooldown as 0.5s for placing the mark and 12s after an attack. Was briefly replaced by Flower Field in V1.81 and reverted in V1.82.

name: Root Swarm
air: air variant (also when facing a gap): semi-blockable, 10 damage, roots become a walkable bridge for 4s
combo: mid-range poke that pulls far targets in toward the user
when_it_whiffs: ground line only; older patch notes say it was blockable at close range
description: Hanami plunges an arm into the ground and sends a line of roots about 50 studs out that lifts enemies and pushes them away; a target hit between 25 and 50 studs is instead pulled toward her onto spikes (which persist for 5 minutes) for a spike bounce. Listed unblockable (made fully unblockable in V1.81; V1.78 said it could be blocked at close range). Plant Guidance variant: unblockable, 12s cooldown, 4 per spike bounce.

name: Surging Thorns
damage: 11 total: 3 per branch (x2) + 5 thorns (possibly reduced by 4 in a later patch)
air: using it in the air or mid-action with a Plant Guidance mark fires the special variant
combo: push into thorns; branches move a blocking target
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; thorn damage blockable from any side; does nothing to ragdolled targets
description: Hanami conjures two wooden balls that sprout sharp branches, pushing any target within their 35-stud range back onto 3 thorns. The branches push even through block but cannot hit ragdolled targets; the thorns can be blocked from all sides. Page lists 11 total, but a later update-log entry says its damage was cut by 4 (and the special variant by 3, or 4 on block breaks); Plant Guidance variant is listed as 6 (8 on interruption) with a 12s cooldown, and rblxguide lists an insta-kill finisher.

name: Bud Shot
combo: pull tool at long range (beyond 35 studs), push at close range; reduces special cooldown
when_it_whiffs: blockable; pushes close targets away instead of pulling
description: Hanami throws two cursed buds 70 studs forward; they push targets within 35 studs away and pull targets that are further out. The buds latch onto the target's torso until that target uses a skill, and each one then cuts her special's cooldown by 7s.

name: Defense Response
air: has an air variant (spike emergence + bounce)
combo: unblockable guard-beater with i-frames
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; cannot hit ragdolled targets
description: Hanami leans back, then surges forward with melee i-frames and swings her arm violently. Ground version is unblockable, 12 damage, and does not cancel/hit a ragdolled target. The air variant is also unblockable and does 14 total: 8 when a spike emerges plus 6 for the spike bounce (with a Plant Guidance mark, using it in the air or mid-action fires from the marked spot).

name: Unwrap (awakening activation)
description: Awakening: heals 25 HP, lasts 60s, uninterruptible. The Fandom entry also lists 30 total damage (6 per spike bounce x5) for the activation and says it resets melee to a 4-hit M1 string worth 14.

name: Energy Absorb / Flower Beam
description: Not in the supplied move list, but both wikis list it under the awakening: Energy Absorb powers up Flower Beam, whose ultimate beam has a 20s cooldown (12s for the special version). Shining Sea of Growing Branches puts Flower Beam off cooldown. No damage or range figures were found.

name: Cursed Buds
combo: area denial turret; summon hit knocks back
when_it_whiffs: buds are blockable unless empowered
description: Hanami summons a large flower that knocks back nearby opponents on arrival and then fires buds like a turret. The empowered version doubles the bud count and makes the buds unblockable.

name: Shining Sea of Growing Branches
combo: lockdown domain; punishes attacks for 15s and resets Flower Beam
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; enemies who only run, side dash or block take nothing
description: Domain: Hanami kneels to draw energy from nearby foliage, and for 15s any enemy action other than running, side dashing or blocking is interrupted and punished with a stun and 4 damage. She stays empowered for the whole duration and Flower Beam comes off cooldown.

name: Flower Field
combo: multi-target bounce
description: A spike emerges and then bounces between targets: per patch notes it can bounce between 2 different targets before disappearing (4 targets, or the same target 4 times, when empowered). Numbers conflict: rblxguide lists 6 on interruption, 12 for emergence, 7 per bounce; Fandom patch history has emergence 8 to 12 and bounce 7 to 14 in V1.82, then all spike bounces 7 to 6 in V1.84. The supplied list shows it both as an awakening move and as the awakening special; Fandom says it replaced Plant Guidance as base special in V1.81 and was reverted in V1.82.

name: Root Rampage
air: air variant is a different attack (Thorn Rampage)
combo: sustained steerable pressure; drains awakening for extra roots
when_it_whiffs: easily interrupted during the ~7s channel
description: Hanami creates a line of roots that can be steered for about 7 seconds, dealing 5 per hit; each extra root costs 15% of the awakening bar. The wiki notes it is easily interrupted.

name: Thorn Rampage (Root Rampage air variant)
when_it_whiffs: dodged by a last-second dash
description: The airborne version of Root Rampage: an unblockable bullet-type attack for 25 damage (reduced from 30 in V1.82). The wiki notes it can be evaded by dashing at the last second.

name: M1 string (Cursed Energy Discharge / Overheat passive)
combo: 3-hit string; final hit is a ray below 90% Overheat
when_it_whiffs: final-hit ray is lost at 90%+ Overheat
description: Ryu's M1 string is 3 hits instead of 4, and while Overheat is under 90% the final neutral M1 fires a ray; that final M1 adds 10% Overheat. At 100% Overheat all Cursed Energy Discharge attacks are disabled until Restyle lowers the meter. Bloxodes lists True Cannon at 100 HP.

name: Granite Blast
combo: spammable ranged stun/poke; held version beats block and counters
when_it_whiffs: tap version is blockable and stops at the first target; wiki says Cursed Energy Discharge attacks are disabled at 100% Overheat
description: A forehead beam that travels 78.5 studs forward and stuns the first person it meets (20% Overheat per shot, 0.5s cooldown). Holding it for about 1.1s charges a version that is unblockable and uncounterable, pierces through 100 studs and deals 12 (6 at longer range) for 40% Overheat. A dash variant deals 4 with a 6s cooldown.

name: Unsatisfied
damage: 18 total: 3 per punch (x3) + 3 back clash + 6 toss (12 on ragdolled targets)
combo: main melee combo move; speeds up Restyle
when_it_whiffs: blockable (extra endlag when blocked) and interruptible
description: A melee string of three punches, a back clash and a toss; holding the move charges the back blast for 3 extra damage. Patch notes: all hits now bypass ragdoll but damage on a ragdolled target is 12 instead of 18, there is more endlag on block, and its knockback was reduced. Each of the first three punches takes 0.5s off Restyle's running cooldown.

name: Second Helping
air: has an air-target variant: 6 punch + 6 extra impact
combo: guard-beating extender that also hits ragdolled/airborne targets
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; reduced hitbox; i-frames start late
description: A single unblockable melee hit with melee i-frames that bypasses ragdoll; against an airborne target it becomes a punch plus an extra impact (6 + 6). The hit takes 3s off Restyle's cooldown. Patch notes shrank its hitbox and delayed the i-frames; a forum wishlist thread claims it is now blockable (unverified).

name: Appetizer
combo: ranged ender that ragdolls
when_it_whiffs: blockable and interruptible; wiki says Cursed Energy Discharge attacks are disabled at 100% Overheat
description: Ryu fires two quick Granite Blasts from his forehead (4 each) and then a vertical ray (8) that ragdolls the target. Adds 30% Overheat (10% per blast).

name: Restyle
combo: resource reset, not an attack
when_it_whiffs: vulnerable during the animation, much more so in the full-Overheat comb variant
description: Lowers the Overheat meter by 60%. At full Overheat it becomes a hair-combing variant that clears Overheat completely but leaves Ryu open for much longer. Its cooldown is shortened by Unsatisfied's punches (0.5s each) and Second Helping (3s).

name: Every Last Drop (awakening activation)
when_it_whiffs: needs Overheat at 80-99% beforehand to enter the awakening state
description: Per the wiki, activating it fires a blast, and Ryu enters the awakening state once the blast dies down if his Overheat was between 80% and 99% beforehand. Awakening lasts 90s, heals 25 HP, sets Overheat to 100% (Decadence passive locks it there and disables the cursed-energy discharge attacks) and turns the awakening bar into a second health bar when low.

name: "What are you after?"
damage: 10 slam + 20 lunge + 5 toss (5 self-damage on launch)
combo: unblockable heavy hitter; picks up ragdolled targets
description: An unblockable melee sequence of a slam, a lunge and a toss that also bypasses ragdoll; Ryu takes 5 self-damage on launch. An air variant was added in a later update.

name: "I had no idea..."
damage: 3 grab + 2 per punch (x7) + 3 push (self-damage 2 + 1 per punch)
description: A melee grab followed by seven punches and a push. Ryu takes self-damage: 2 on the grab and 1 per punch.

name: "This is what dessert is like!"
damage: 7 kick + 3 swing + 5 per hit (x4) + 6 push (self-damage 2 per blow and on push)
description: A melee string: kick, swing, four heavier hits and a push. Ryu takes 2 self-damage per blow and on the push.

name: "You weren't invited."
combo: chargeable burst / finisher
description: An explosion-type attack that deals 20, or 40 when held to full charge. Its awakening finisher version is an insta-kill on the same 20s cooldown. Added in the V1.71-V1.80 update range; the source did not give its shape or range.

name: M1 string
combo: final M1 / uppercut speeds up Discard
description: No M1 damage numbers were found. Landing an uppercut or the final neutral M1 cuts Discard's cooldown by 5s (patch notes say downslams no longer do).

name: Discard
combo: hand management: cycle to the move the situation needs
when_it_whiffs: not an attack; 25s cooldown (minus 5s per final M1 or uppercut)
description: Swaps one of the four receipts in hand for the NEXT move, keeping the discarded move's current cooldown; discarding a sealed move removes its seal. Rotation: 12 base receipts, 4 usable at a time plus a NEXT slot. A used move goes to the back of the queue and returns via the NEXT slot once the rest have been used. Opening hand is Gushing Wound, Homerun, Littering, Pole Vault with Coupon in NEXT, then Piano Drop, Garage Sale, Blunt Trauma, Drone Strike, Fleche, Extra Coupon, Speed Crash.

name: Con Artistry (awakening activation)
description: Awakening: heals 25 HP and lasts 90s. It lets Reggie replace a base receipt with one of four awakening moves, each use costing a percentage of awakening progress.

name: Coupon
combo: setup: upgrades the next receipt to its red-seal version
description: Using Coupon and then another move applies a red seal that empowers that move (up to 3 moves can be sealed, since Coupon occupies the 4th slot); using Coupon twice seals the NEXT move instead. Cooldown 5s (reduced from 8s).

name: Extra Coupon
description: A second coupon receipt later in the rotation that also applies red seals; rblxguide lists an 8s cooldown. No further detail was found.

name: Gushing Wound
combo: ranged starter: ragdolls an unblocking target
when_it_whiffs: no ragdoll if blocked; cannot hit ragdolled targets
description: Reggie throws a knife that ragdolls the target unless blocked and applies one Bleed stack that cannot progress into Hemorrhage. Both wikis tag it unblockable; a forum analysis clarifies that blocking avoids the ragdoll but not the damage. Red seal: six knives in a diagonal spread, with reduced damage and no extra Bleed on repeat hits to one target.

name: Homerun
combo: guard break / launcher ender
when_it_whiffs: noticeable startup; cannot hit ragdolled targets
description: A bat swing with a startup that launches the target upward and away; it is a block-breaking melee hit, and deals 15 when it bats a throwable. Red seal: conjures a ricocheting baseball that gains damage after about 20 studs, slows after 233 studs and bypasses a blocking opponent's guard.

name: Littering
combo: two-press trap: place, then detonate to launch and pull
when_it_whiffs: needs the second press and an enemy near the receipts; blockable from any side
description: Reggie throws receipts onto the ground in front of him; using the move again turns them into yoga balls that bounce targets upward and pull nearby enemies in. Non-blocking targets are flung up and ragdolled; it can be blocked from all sides and it does hit ragdolled targets.

name: Pole Vault
when_it_whiffs: interruptible
description: An unblockable, interruptible melee kick that bypasses ragdoll (patch notes mention the kick going from 5 to 7 damage); the source did not describe the vault movement itself. Red seal: a second receipt keeps the move off cooldown so it can be used again. Cooldown conflicts: rblxguide says 14s, the Fandom entry was read as 8s.

name: Piano Drop
combo: unblockable area hit that also reaches ragdolled targets
when_it_whiffs: interruptible; small 7x7 landing area
description: Drops a piano for an unblockable explosion over a small 7x7 area. Red seal: three bricks weigh it down, widening the area to 14x14 with a large shockwave and 19 damage at the centre. A patch note quoted in a forum post lists base damage going from 14 to 12; both wikis still show 14.

name: Garage Sale
combo: multi-hit ranged pressure
when_it_whiffs: blockable; interruptible during windup
description: A barrage of thrown furniture after a short windup (reduced by 0.25s in a patch). Fandom tags it semi-blockable, rblxguide and a forum analysis call it blockable; it bypasses ragdoll. Red seal: adds a fridge launched after a short delay for 5 more damage (17 total).

name: Blunt Trauma
combo: hit-confirm string that cripples movement for 4s
when_it_whiffs: first swing must connect; blockable and interruptible
description: A melee swing that, if it lands, continues into two more swings and a crushing final blow that disables the target's dashing, running and jumping for 4 seconds. A forum post lists the damage as 14/4 instead.

name: Drone Strike
combo: two-press explosive
when_it_whiffs: needs the second press to detonate
description: Deploys two drones; pressing the move again sends them into each other to trigger an explosion. Sources disagree: rblxguide (newer) lists 12 damage, 10s cooldown, unblockable; Fandom lists 14s and unblockable; a forum post says the base version is blockable without Coupon and drone damage is 10.

name: Fleche
combo: gap closer that pulls the target back for a follow-up
when_it_whiffs: blockable and interruptible; straight-line dash; cannot hit ragdolled targets
description: Reggie winds up and dashes forward like an arrow, stabbing the enemy and then pulling them back toward him with a short ragdoll.

name: Speed Crash
when_it_whiffs: hitting a wall or obstacle damages the user
description: An unblockable explosion-type move; the only behaviour the source gave is that meeting an enemy triggers the explosion immediately, while crashing into an obstacle also damages Reggie (so it involves the user travelling). The red-seal version deals 14.

name: Road Rage
combo: area burst at an aimed spot
description: Three conjured cars drive toward a targeted area; each car stops working after it has crashed into two targets. Costs 5% of the awakening bar.

name: 132-Square-Foot Two-Story House
combo: high-damage finisher
description: Reggie's biggest awakening move: 35 on the initial hit and 90 on a second impact, for 10% of the awakening bar. Its finisher version is an insta-kill. The source gave no description of how it is aimed.

name: Big Moves
combo: straight-line burst / finisher
when_it_whiffs: a target standing in the gap between the two trucks is not hit by the crash
description: Two trucks charge forward and explode. There is a small gap between the two trucks in which a target avoids the crash. Costs 7% of the awakening bar; its finisher version is an insta-kill with a 21s cooldown.

name: Mayhem
air: source says the user can float down with an umbrella afterwards
combo: area damage plus self-heal
description: Reggie drops explosive receipts along with a spa ticket that heals him 12.5 HP, and can float down with an umbrella. Costs 5% of the awakening bar.
